lines:
Transactional validation and persistence boundary for formal C4 elements, relationships, Mermaid UML artifacts, code bindings, UI mockups, and AI-proposed mockup revisions. Implemented contract: an existing independently editable design document is updated or deleted using its stable document identity and the opaque readToken returned with the complete document; updates also supply the proposed content. Adashi computes the token as a hash of the canonical editable document, derives dependency checks internally, and atomically compares the token, validates syntax and current references, and commits. Agents do not construct guard readSet or writeSet parameters. A mismatch returns an MCP tool error with code out_of_date, stored false, the document identity, full currentDocument and its fresh readToken from one consistent snapshot, and an explicit request to merge the intended changes into currentDocument and retry with that token. No part of the attempted write is saved and the project cursor is unchanged. The agent must merge, not merely replace the token on its old payload; every retry is checked again. A successful write returns the new readToken. Creates require an absent identity and no previous token. Multi-document writes check all affected document tokens and commit all or nothing. Independent documents do not share a project-wide token. Idempotent retries, generated-artifact protection, semantic no-op handling, structural dependency checks, correct formal syntax, and mockup acceptance boundaries remain required. The MCP save request uses operationId, changeIntent, changes, and readTokens pairs of documentId/readToken for existing targets; set_element_descriptions uses operationId, readTokens, and updates. Missing existing-target tokens return read_required with the current document. Single conflicts expose documentId/currentDocument/readToken directly; multiple conflicts use a conflicts array without duplicating complete bodies. Saved request fingerprints reject operationId reuse with changed arguments.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Extend adashi_design/save with closed-schema upsert_markdown {externalId,title,body,designLinks} and delete_markdown {externalId}; designLinks are ordered typed stable target identities and can be empty for a project document. Extend binding targets and delete dependency checking to Markdown. Reuse operationId/changeIntent/readTokens and all existing atomic conflict/idempotency semantics. Agents create/edit/delete official narrative design through this API only; raw filesystem paths are not canonical identity. New documents require no previous token; existing ones require their complete-read token. Rejected saves leave all content/references unchanged. Return stable identity and the updated complete-document token through normal save results. Generated output refresh failure is reported separately from an already committed save. Update adashi_help filtered variants, tools/list JSON schema, examples, validation diagnostics and backend-neutral dispatch together.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.
